charge_port.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: only the 2026+ IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9 have a NACS port; other Hyundai EVs of MY2025 and earlier (and 2026 KONA Electric) have CCS and use an adapter. CCS1 inferred for the IONIQ 6 (not named on the page).

supercharger_access.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: Hyundai EVs of MY2025 and earlier can use a NACS adapter (available separately; separate Hyundai Canada free-adapter offer until 2026-12-31 for eligible models).
